links.outcome: Data leakage risk and temporal inconsistencies in radiology no-show model development and validation
links.effect: Models trained on 2022-2023 data and tested on 2024 data reached best AUC 0.71; temporal inconsistencies highlighted data leakage risk, and data quality varied across features and sites.
links.quote: Feature engineering was constrained by predictor granularity, and temporal inconsistencies highlighted the risk of data leakage.

unlisted_practices: Integrating external weather, socioeconomic, and crime data as predictors (little utility found)

screen.reason: Evaluates predictive models for radiology no-shows using retrospective and temporal holdout data, highlighting methodological pitfalls like data leakage and feature quality for deployment readiness, but does not test a specific operational deployment practice or safeguard.
